metadata.description: Bookkeeping skills for AI agents — getting small businesses and freelancers caught up on their books before a deadline, keeping them caught up, and paying quarterly taxes on time

plugins.name: bookkeeping-ops-skills
plugins.description: Bookkeeping skills plus a shared context file: a catch-up plan that turns months of unfinished books into a dated, deadline-first plan with a do-it-yourself vs. hire estimate and CPA questions, delivered as an Excel workbook, plus a quarterly tax set-aside that works out each quarter's safe payment from last year's return, a set-aside rate on profit, and what to do if you already owe
